prior_evidence.discovery: DISCLOSED: the fill mechanism was found on July 2025 development rows (a recipe month): the ten July matched-scope rows carrying 86% of nnl's deficit against the tree table have labels equal to the schedule interval within seconds and ordinary NM clocks. January, November and December were inspected only through label-free counts of gated rows. The thresholds (30 and 60 minutes) were fixed without scoring any gated candidate.
prior_evidence.nn3: adsb_nn3's selection (runs/adsb_nn3/dev/selection.json) is a parent; its LIRF networks are named on the command line.
prior_evidence.rationale: adsb_nn3 selected nothing (the NM-clock-residual LIRF network is not better than nnl: November worse for every candidate); as agreed with the user, the gate round uses the winning LIRF network, v25's nnl.
prior_evidence.v30: with nnl and no gate, the matched weight 0.30 is the optimum (0.45: July +0.084%, December -0.031%).

configuration.purpose: A fill gate on the LIRF network. July's long non-population LIRF rows are schedule fills (label = scheduled time to takeoff within seconds, NM clock proxy 700-1,300 s); the tree table predicts toward the schedule interval there and every network an ordinary taxi, which is why v25's network cannot take more than 0.30 (adsb_v30). On scope rows where the tree table exceeds the NM clock proxy by more than T the network's weight returns to the tree table; elsewhere the network may take more weight. Fits nothing.
configuration.selection: A candidate is eligible when: no recipe month is worse on ALL rows (ratio to the control <= 1.0); the mean ratio over the four recipe months is at least 0.02% below 1; and on every month where it changes a row the paired-day bootstrap 95% interval of the RMSE difference against the control lies below zero. Among eligible candidates choose the lowest mean ratio (ties by name); otherwise select nothing and keep v25. The rule of every round since adsb_v25, unchanged.
configuration.ship: If a candidate is selected: every twelve-month refit exists; v25 is rebuilt from its recorded components and must reproduce the uploaded v25 exactly; the selected LIRF network, weights and gate are applied; exported as the next version, verified independently (the gate recomputed from the export detail), audited, and uploaded only with the user's approval. Non-LIRF rows must equal the uploaded v25.
